verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a desktop client exists (a dedicated /desktop page), files stay synced across devices, and shared-folder changes sync almost instantly. It also claims you can store content in the cloud and save hard drive space, which hints at on-demand or online-only files. None of this is detailed, and platform coverage and selective sync are never stated. Missing for 10: explicit macOS and Windows client documentation, selective sync evidence, explicit online-only/on-demand file documentation, and independent hands-on corroboration of sync reliability.
